questions.question: Which state's government declared May 5 as Traders Day to honor the business community?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Tamil Nadu government has declared May 5 as Traders Day to honor the business community.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tamil Nadu CM MK Stalin announced that May 5 will be declared as Traders Day, honoring the business community.**
 
• The decision follows demands from the business sector and aligns with the Dravidian Model government’s support for trade.
 
• CM Stalin also highlighted Tamil Nadu's achievements in higher education, including a leading GER of 47% and top colleges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Dravidian Model Government__

 __
 
• The Dravidian Model government emphasizes social justice, education, and economic development, with a strong focus on supporting business communities and trade.
 
 
 
• Tamil Nadu's Achievements in Higher Education__
 
 
• Tamil Nadu has achieved a significant Gross Enrollment Ratio (GER) of 47%, making it a leader in higher education among Indian states.

questions.question: Who launched the first edition of the nationwide 'Hack-AI-thon' to promote AI-based innovation in the insurance sector?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**SBI Life Insurance.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **SBI Life Insurance launched the first edition of its nationwide 'Hack-AI-thon' initiative.**
 
• **The initiative aims to encourage tech students to address challenges in the insurance sector using artificial intelligence.**
 
• **The event witnessed participation from over 7,500 students, with 50 teams shortlisted for the finale in Mumbai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **SBI Life Insurance__ launched the first-ever nationwide 'Hack-AI-thon' to promote AI solutions in the insurance domain.**
 
• The competition drew over 7,500 student participants from across India.
 
• Top 50 teams were selected to showcase their ideas in the grand finale in Mumbai.
 
• Focus areas included improving customer experience, fraud detection, and accessibility of insurance products.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

• SBI Life Insurance__

 __

• Headquartered in Mumbai
 
• Offers a range of life insurance and pension products
 
 
 
• Hack-AI-thon Objectives__
 __
 
• Leverage AI to enhance operational efficiency in insurance
 
• Encourage innovation among young tech talent
 
• Address sectoral challenges like fraud, accessibility, and personalization
 
 
 
• Grand Finale__
 
 
• To be held in Mumbai
 
• Top solutions will be evaluated by industry experts
 
• Winning teams may get opportunities for incubation or deployment

questions.question: Kirana Hills, known for its geological and strategic significance, is situated in which country?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Kirana Hills, located in the Sargodha District of Punjab, Pakistan, is known for its geological features and strategic military importance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kirana Hills is situated in the Sargodha District of Punjab province in Pakistan.**
 
• The range is often referred to as the Black Mountains due to its dark and rocky terrain.
 
• It holds geological significance due to deposits of uranium and rock types like quartzites and slates.
 
• The hills also serve strategic military functions with radar stations and underground tunnel networks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Geological Composition__

 __
 
• Includes hardened shales, slates, and quartzites
 
• Uranium deposits identified during surveys in the 1970s
 
 
 
• Strategic Importance__
 __
 
• Used for military radar and surveillance infrastructure
 
• Tunnel systems are believed to be part of defense-related activities
 
 
 
• Sargodha District__
 __
 
• Located in Punjab province of Pakistan
 
• Known for its military air base and strategic installations
 
 
 
• Nickname: Black Mountains__
 
 
• Due to the dark appearance of the rocky terrain
 
• Contributes to the hills’ visibility and uniqueness in the region

questions.question: What species of turtle was recently reintroduced to the Ganga River after a 30-year absence?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Red-Crowned Roofed Turtle.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The endangered Red-Crowned Roofed Turtle was reintroduced to the Ganga River after an absence of 30 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The reintroduction took place in the Haiderpur Wetland Complex along the Ganga in Uttar Pradesh on April 26, 2025.**
 
• 20 Red-Crowned Roofed Turtles were released as part of a conservation effort supported by the Namami Gange Mission.
 
• The turtles were equipped with sonic tags to monitor their movements and ensure their safety.
 
• The goal is to establish a self-sustaining population of this critically endangered species in the Ganga River.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Namami Gange Mission__

 __
 
• Launched by the Government of India to clean and rejuvenate the Ganga River.
 
• A key initiative for environmental conservation and biodiversity restoration in the Ganga basin.
 
 
 
• Red-Crowned Roofed Turtle__
 __
 
• A critically endangered species of turtle that was once native to the Ganga River but had disappeared due to population decline.
 
 
 
• Haiderpur Wetland Complex__
 __
 
• Located along the Ganga River in Uttar Pradesh, it provides an ideal environment for the reintroduction of species like the Red-Crowned Roofed Turtle.
 
 
 
• Sonic Tags__
 
 
• Technology used to monitor the movements and ensure the safety of animals during conservation efforts.

questions.question: Which treaty was suspended by Pakistan in retaliation to India's withdrawal from the Indus Waters Treaty?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Shimla Agreement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Pakistan suspended the Shimla Agreement in retaliation to India's withdrawal from the Indus Waters Treaty.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Shimla Agreement was signed between India and Pakistan after the 1971 war to restore peace and resolve issues bilaterally.**
 
• The agreement led to the establishment of the Line of Control (LoC) in Kashmir, replacing the previous ceasefire line.
 
• It also facilitated the formal recognition of Bangladesh and the release of 93,000 Pakistani prisoners of war.
 
• Pakistan’s suspension of the Shimla Agreement came in response to India’s move to withdraw from the Indus Waters Treaty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Lahore Declaration__

 __
 
• Signed in - 1999
 
• Between - India and Pakistan
 
• Aimed to strengthen peace and security, and resolve Kashmir conflict
 
 
 
• Tashkent Agreement__
 __
 
• Signed in - 1966
 
• Between - India and Pakistan
 
• Focus - Restoration of territories captured during the 1965 war
 
 
 
• Karachi Agreement__
 
 
• Signed in - 1949
 
• Between - India and Pakistan
 
• Focus - Ceasefire line in Kashmir post-1947 war

questions.question: Vishnu Prasad, who recently passed away associated with which field?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Acting.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Vishnu Prasad was a renowned Malayalam actor known for his compelling performances in negative roles.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vishnu Prasad passed away at the age of 52 while undergoing treatment for liver disease in Ernakulam.**
 
• He was well-known for his roles in negative characters, which added depth and complexity to the films he starred in.
 
• During his treatment, Vishnu Prasad faced financial hardships, and the Association of Television Media Artists (ATMA) along with fellow actors offered financial support for his treatment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Negative Role Actor__

 __
 
• Negative role actors play antagonistic characters, often providing the conflict or challenge for the protagonist in a film or TV show.
 
• Such roles often require a deep understanding of human emotions, which Vishnu Prasad showcased through his performances.
 
 
 
• Financial Support for Actors__
 
 
• The support provided by ATMA and fellow actors is an example of the industry's solidarity during difficult times for its members.

questions.question: When is World Thyroid Day celebrated every year?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**25 May**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Thyroid Day: 25 May.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**World Thyroid Day** is celebrated every year on **25th May**.

 
 
• 
 
It was decided during the **Thyroid Federation International** meeting in **September 2007**.

 
 
• 
 
The first World Thyroid Day was celebrated in **2008**.

 
 
• 
 
The **theme** for this year is **“Thyroid Disease and Artificial Intelligence”**.

 
 
• 
 
The **European Thyroid Association** also started **European Thyroid Day** on **25th May 2008**.

questions.question: What is the name of the U.S. legislation that criminalizes the non-consensual sharing of intimate images and deepfakes?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Take It Down Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• US Passes Take It Down Act.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Take It Down Act** was signed into law by **U.S. President Donald Trump**.

 
 
• 
 
The law **criminalizes** the **non-consensual sharing** of **intimate images**, including **AI-generated deepfakes**.

 
 
• 
 
It is now **illegal to knowingly publish or threaten to publish such content** without the subject’s consent.

 
 
• 
 
**Websites and social media** platforms must **remove the reported content within 48 hours** of notification from a victim.

 
 
• 
 
Platforms are also required to **remove duplicate content** to prevent further spread.

 
 
• 
 
**Deepfakes** are **AI-generated synthetic media**, often created using **Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)**.

 
 
• 
 
These can **falsely depict people** in realistic scenarios they were never involved in, posing **serious privacy and reputational threats**.

 
 
• 
 
The law responds to the **rapid growth of deepfake technology** outpacing current regulations worldwide.
